说明: 修 bug、加功能和守规矩加代码质量（11-08 起）；S2 = 判对错 70% + 代码质量 30%。代码质量由独立评审（Claude，新开的子会话）只看随机甲乙标签的改动打分，打完才揭晓；评审没看过工具的对话和用时。

理由.结构与分层: 翻页只把游标时间传进 search，保留 rowid 即时间的原设计；排序修在合并排序与挪动两处。
理由.可读性: 注释讲清中点等于邻居会弹回、游标条目被删或前移的原因；search 里按探测窗口取实际 rowid 的判断稍绕。
理由.一致性: 魔法数 8 提成 rankProbeLimit 复用，新 rank(of:) 沿用原有写法并区分无行与出错。
理由.稳健写法: 新键须严格落在两邻居之间，否则整体重排且跳过未变的记录；同毫秒碰撞加游标被删时仍有极端漏重可能。
理由.可维护性: 测试覆盖 trigram 与短词两路、60 组拖动和 80 次挤缝；moved 辅助函数复刻了夹取逻辑。

理由_en.结构与分层: Paging only passes the cursor time into search, keeping the original "rowid is time" design; the ordering fix is in the merge sort and in moving.
理由_en.可读性: Comments explain why a midpoint equal to a neighbor bounces back and what happens when the cursor item is deleted or moved; the probe-window check for the real rowid in search is a bit convoluted.
理由_en.一致性: The magic number 8 becomes a reused rankProbeLimit constant, and the new rank(of:) follows the existing style and tells "no row" apart from an error.
理由_en.稳健写法: A new key must fall strictly between its two neighbors or the list is renumbered, skipping unchanged items; a same-millisecond collision combined with a deleted cursor can still, in extreme cases, skip or repeat an item.
理由_en.可维护性: Tests cover both the trigram and short-query paths, 60 drag sequences and 80 squeezes into a gap; the moved test helper duplicates the clamping logic.

理由.结构与分层: 为修翻页把索引升到 schema 2，加新列、两个索引、JOIN 查询和原地升级，超出修 bug 所需。
理由.可读性: search 拼接多段 SQL 字符串，绑定序号靠 cursor == nil ? 2 : 4 推算，不易一眼看清。
理由.一致性: 弃用 rowid 即时间的原设计、删掉实测性能注释，Entry 改字段牵动旧测试，索引层依赖 ClipCursor。
理由.稳健写法: 按（时间, uuid）翻页，同毫秒也不漏不重；isFinite 与升级置待修补周到，但升级后列可空与新建不一致。
理由.可维护性: 补了迁移测试和同毫秒翻页测试，覆盖较全，但引入 schema 迁移与查询计划提示，后续维护负担明显加重。

理由_en.结构与分层: Upgrades the index to schema 2 to fix paging, adding a column, two indexes, a JOIN query and an in-place migration, far beyond what the bug needs.
理由_en.可读性: search concatenates several SQL strings, and bind positions have to be worked out from cursor == nil ? 2 : 4; hard to read at a glance.
理由_en.一致性: Drops the original "rowid is time" design and removes a measured performance comment; changing Entry fields forces old tests to change, and the index layer now depends on ClipCursor.
理由_en.稳健写法: Pages by (time, uuid), so nothing is skipped or repeated even within the same millisecond; the isFinite checks and repair-on-upgrade are careful, but after the upgrade the column is nullable, unlike in new databases.
理由_en.可维护性: Adds migration and same-millisecond paging tests with good coverage, but the schema migration and query-plan hints add a clear ongoing maintenance burden.
